face_registration.reference: Established character portrait and earlier card identity
face_registration.adopted_region: Localized face only; original pose, costume, hands and source alpha preserved
face_registration.eye_states: Fresh closed-eye painting and individually registered open/half/closed contours
face_registration.derivatives: Standard and high-resolution portrait, body layer, thumbnail, five-character illustration and pool cover

sampling: Lanczos3 unless the theme records a different method below; larger derivatives do not add native detail.
compositing: Background first, then registered transparent foreground using source-over. Existing rare cards retain their registered motion composition.

seasonal.eyeRegistration: Same full-canvas coordinates; half and closed layers retain only the face region.
seasonal.scaling: Portraits and group: same-source Lanczos resampling. Cover: existing enhanced foreground with the cleaned current alpha and the same adopted background. Large dimensions do not imply native added detail.

christmas.eyeRegistration: Only registered eye pixels change; the original alpha and body remain shared.
christmas.scaling: Canvas2D high-quality resampling; larger dimensions do not add native detail.
christmas.layering: Registered independent hair, cloth and accessories; opaque body and transparent gown for Claude; weather and light use room masks.
